tools.name: list_llc_dissolution_fees
tools.description: List the LLC dissolution filing fee for all 50 US states and DC, quoted exactly as each state publishes it, marking the states where the filing fee is not the whole cost. Use when someone compares costs across states or asks which states charge to close an LLC.
